children.name: Outcome 1.1 Rights holders in Malawi access more accountable and effective institutions at the central and decentralised levels that use quality disaggregated data, offer integrated service delivery and promote civic engagement, respect for human rights and rule of law

Output 1.1.1 - State and non-state institutions and legal frameworks strengthened to coordinate, promote partnerships and accountability, access to justice and human rights by marginalized groups in line with international obligations.
Output 1.1.2 - Malawi has strengthened decentralized sectors and local governance structures for effective service delivery, development planning and SDGs acceleration.

Output 1.1.3 - Oversight institutions and civil society enabled to engage duty bearers to ensure increased demand for accountability, responsiveness and active, free and meaningful participation of rights holders including marginalized groups in decision-making at all levels.

Output 1.1.4 - Public institutions and non-state actors capable of collecting, analyzing, sharing, and utilizing disaggregated data and digital technologies for evidence-based policies and programs for improved responsiveness, targeting, impact and monitoring of SDGs and other normative frameworks.
Outcome 1.2 Gender equality and the empowerment of women and girls in Malawi is enhanced
Output 1.2.1 - National gender machinery with enhanced capabilities in coordination, management, formulation and implementation of transformative gender programs and gender related laws and policies.
Output 1.2.2 - Strengthened capabilities of Government and CSOs to implement, monitor and report on global, regional and national obligations on GEWE.
Output 1.2.3 - Public institutions and CSOs capable of producing and using knowledge products and analytical reports on gender equality and empowerment of women and girls.

children.name: Outcome 1.3 Malawi has strengthened institutional capacities for sustaining peace, inclusive societies and participatory democracy
children.description: Improved participation and representation of women, youth, the elderly, People with Disabilities, and People with Albinism through activities intended to foster participation and ownership of the electoral processes. Peace: Reduced tensions and disputes regarding the electoral process through the establishment or strengthening and of existing mechanisms contributing to conflict prevention and mitigation.

children.name: Output 1.3.1 - Real-time conflict early warning and response mechanisms for monitoring conflicts and threats to peace.
Output 1.3.2 - Governance, electoral management and peacebuilding institutions strengthened to promote inclusive, transparent and peaceful societies.
children.description:
UNDP:
UNDP has been working with the Malawi Electoral Commission to conduct a post-2020 electoral review process and consolidate the gains.  This includes the review of electoral laws and building capacities of MEC staff. UNDP has also supported the Center for Multiparty Democracy (CMD) to assist Political party dialogue and conflict prevention activities during by-elections conducted in 2021. Furthermore,  UNDP has engaged in a drive to digitalize the Parliament of Malawi to ensure that it is effective and efficient in delivering its representative, oversight, and legislative roles. 

UN Women: Supported capacity strengthening through training of district and community level stakeholder i.e., District Gender Technical working group and 10 Village Development Committees in Rumphi District. These are supporting implementation of UNSCR 1325 by ensuring women’s inclusion and participation in conflict prevention and peace building, women's participation in leadership in community structures such as VDCs and ADCs, including prevention of Gender Based Violence as a women's peace and security issue. These groups are expected to continue supporting gendered responses in security and humanitarian responses in the district. A total of 135 (108 Female and 27 Male) were trained and supported to engage at community level to support peace building and conflict prevention.
